svg.text: The 33-byte packet: the same form at both ends
struct Node2Packet in node2-packet.h · read from left to right, bytes 0 to 32
A real example from Wokwi (Practice 2): no BME280, DS18B20 27.0 °C, potentiometer 55%
Little-endian: numbers longer than one byte are written smallest byte first.
2C 01 means 0x012C = 300. Node 1 and Node 2 are both ESP32s, so the layout matches at both ends.
